cohort: 277 late preterm infants (153 singletons and 124 twins) hospitalised in NICU, University Hospital Center 'Sisters of Mercy' Zagreb, Croatia, over a 36-month period
finding: Late preterm twin infants did not have a more favorable neonatal outcome compared with singleton late preterm infants born at the same gestational age.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was smaller in the twin group
